sections.name: Lantern Mine
sections.danger: Safe working mine
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): the starter mine in Rabbit Lands kit art - a headframe over the shaft out with daylight down it, rails down the main drift, ore carts, sledges, crates and tool racks, warm lanterns, veined crags along the walls. Layout, nodes and its peace kept. Rooms in order: shaft foot, main drift, west cut, east cut, south cut. Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): its ore set into wall veins and a crawl through the south rockfall to the Old Seam.

sections.name: Pinebrow Deep Workings
sections.danger: Kobolds and spiders in the lower cuts
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): the mine kit with a darker, deeper feel - collapsed rockfall, ore carts left in the drifts, vein scree, copper-veined crags along the walls. Layout, nodes and encounters kept. Rooms in order: shaft foot, main drift, west cut, east cut, lower cuts. Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): its ore set into wall veins and a stair down from the west cut to the Deep Workings.

sections.name: Cenote Deeps
sections.danger: Cave spiders and a moss golem
sections.about: Owner 2026-10-20: a jungle cenote laid out like the reference undergrounds - an entry grotto, a winding root tunnel, the great sinkhole with its pool, waterfall and daylight shaft, and three side caves (Drowned Gallery west, Glowmoss Grotto east, Root Crawl south-east). Rooms in order: grotto, cenote, gallery, glowmoss, crawl. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): only its ore moved into wall veins, and a flooded way in the Root Crawl leads under the sea to the Undercity below Suncoil.

sections.name: Boarsend Old Barrow
sections.danger: Skeletons beyond the burial hall
sections.about: Wave 1 refresh (owner 2026-10-20): drystone and moor boulders for walls; a giant skeleton in the burial hall, grave markers, candle stakes and cold wisp lanterns. Layout, nodes and encounters kept. Rooms in order: entry, hub, west grave chamber, golem chamber, burial hall. Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): its ore set into wall veins.

sections.name: The Old Warren
sections.danger: Rabbits, shrews, hedgehogs and stoats in the burrows; a badger and a mole in the deep runs
sections.about: Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): the warren Rabbit Lands is named for, regrown as a burrow hub under the west - a web of dens round the great den, a ring of dens and narrow runs round that, and five burrows up: two on Warrenmead, one each on Landfall, Twinbrook and Stagheath. Daylight falls through burrow holes. Rooms in order: north-west web den, north web den, north-east web den, west web den, great den, east web den, south-west web den, south web den, south-east web den, west den, rabbit den, queen's hall, root den, north den, Warrenmead burrow (west), Warrenmead burrow (south), Landfall burrow, Twinbrook burrow, Stagheath burrow, fern den, mole run den, badger sett, hedgehog den, stoat den, west nest, south-west nest, south-east nest, east nest, north nest.

sections.name: The Amethyst Geode
sections.danger: Crystal beetles, dire wolves and an amethyst golem among the crystal pillars
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): one vast geode under Saltsound's amethyst crater, the great amethyst cluster at its heart, opening east into a cavern of crystal-lined chambers looping round rock pillars (DP Crystal Caverns' layout). Rooms in order: way in, great geode, then the 5 x 4 lattice of crystal chambers, row by row.

sections.name: Brambleshaw Undercroft
sections.danger: Giant moles and nightweave spiders in the vaults, a zombie in the old crypt
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): the wine cellars under Brambleshaw's old chapel - a cut-stone grid of barrel vaults round two piers, a press room, and a smugglers' crawl down to a forgotten crypt. Rooms in order: chapel stair, barrel vault, west cellar, press room, east vault, smugglers' hole, old crypt. Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): its ore set into wall veins.

sections.name: Smugglers' Grotto
sections.danger: Tide crabs and lobsters on the ledges, snapping turtles in the channel, a drowned pirate over the contraband
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): a sea cave running under Greenlight's neck from the lighthouse to a sea mouth on the tidal flats' north shore - the smugglers' shortcut. A ledge path along a tidal channel with moored boats, a contraband store looping off the ledge, the smugglers' hold, a wreck cove and daylight through the sea arch by the mouth. Rooms in order: stair up to the lighthouse, lantern ledge, boat cave, contraband store, the hold, sea-arch cave, sea mouth, wreck cove.

sections.name: The Resin Hollow
sections.danger: Amber lantern moths and mossback badgers in the roots, ember leaf spirits by the amber pools
sections.about: Wave 2 (owner 2026-10-20): under Twinbrook's great amber oak - a star of chambers round the vast root hall at its heart, glowing amber pools, the resin cutters' taps and drying racks, and daylight down the hollow trunk. Rooms in order: root door, heart of the oak, amber grotto, sap pool, deep root, cutters' camp. Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): clay and flint veins in its root walls; resin and sap stay open.

sections.name: Ravenhead Basalt Tubes
sections.danger: Ashen wolves in the tubes, cave salamanders by the ember vents and an obsidian bear in its den
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): old lava tubes running under the ridge from Ravenhead's basalt headland to Ringholm's plateau - a tunnel between the regions. Long tubes between column halls, twin tubes round a great basalt pillar, a squeeze into the ember vents and a bear's den off the great hall. Rooms in order: way in from Ravenhead, column hall, twin-tube hall, ember vents, great column hall, the den, way out to Ringholm.

sections.name: Saltwind Caves
sections.danger: Scorpions and frilled lizards in the halls, cobras in the salt drift, an ashen wolf at the tomb
sections.about: Pass 2 wave B (owner 2026-10-21): wind-carved sandstone halls under the Ringholm-Saltsound border, a tunnel between the regions - a wind hall lit from above, a hoodoo gallery with a slot behind a sandstone pier, the old salt drift with its rails, the salt cavern and a Sunmane tomb in a side branch. Rooms in order: way in from Ringholm, wind hall, hoodoo gallery, salt drift, salt cavern, Sunmane tomb, way out to Saltsound.

sections.name: Rimewater Ice Caves
sections.danger: Yetis, frost golems and glacier trolls; the Rime Matriarch has left her throne for the Frozen Deep below
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): a winding crevasse under Whitepeak's glacier temple climbs to a frozen waterfall hall under a daylight shaft, branching to an icicle gallery, an abandoned frost mine and the rime throne, in cold blue light. Walkable ledges (the owner's experiment): a terrace at the foot of the frozen falls and the throne's dais, each reached by a ramp. Rooms in order: crevasse foot, frozen falls, icicle gallery, frost mine, rime throne. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the frost mine's adit (room 5) runs out to a second door on Whitepeak's south face, a shortcut under the glacier; the Rime Matriarch left her throne for the bottom of the Frozen Deep, and the throne cave holds the stair down to it. Ore in wall veins.

sections.name: Serpent Catacombs
sections.danger: Skeletons, gargoyles and mummies; the sanctum stair goes down to the Undercity
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): a formal cross of cut-stone halls under Suncoil's temple precinct - a processional lined with burial niches, a transept, two ossuary wings and the sanctum of the Drowned Lich King. Rooms in order: temple stair, processional, four burial niches, transept, sanctum, west ossuary, east ossuary. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the entry level of the Serpent Underways. The Drowned Lich King went down to the Sunken Sanctum; his emptied sanctum holds the stair down into the Undercity. Ore in wall veins.

sections.name: Mirror Vaults
sections.danger: Crystal automatons, rune golems and the void construct in the sealed vault
sections.about: Wave 3 (owner 2026-10-20): square vaults on a loop under Hornmere's citadel - a lens hall where the giant lens focuses a daylight beam onto a reflecting pool, a gallery of mirror obelisks, an obelisk court and the sealed vault. Rooms in order: vault door, lens hall, mirror gallery, obelisk court, sealed vault. Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the stair up from the Frozen Deep opens in the vault-door hall, the end of the way under the isle from Whitepeak to Hornmere. Ore in wall veins.

sections.name: The Old Seam
sections.danger: Safe: a worked-out drift with its richest seam left in the walls
sections.about: Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): a rich starter seam behind the collapsed south drift of the Lantern Mine, reached only by the crawl through the rockfall. Coal, iron and copper still line its walls. Rooms in order: the old face, the side cuts.

sections.name: The Deep Workings
sections.danger: Kobolds, nightweave spiders, moles and lizards in the drifts; gremlins and sporefolk in the far cuts
sections.about: Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): the old company's deep mine under Pinebrow - reached down the stair from the Pinebrow workings and out by the adit on Boarsend. Long drifts with working faces at their dead ends, two pillar halls, iron, copper, coal, slate and sulfur left in the walls. Parts in order: trunk, great hall, east drift, west drift, down drift, lower hall, adit, south drift, east spur, north-west drift, middle drift, west drive.

sections.name: Heath Barrow
sections.danger: Ravens, stoats and an imp among the old graves
sections.about: Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): a burial pocket under the heath - a short passage down, the burial chamber with its grave markers and candles, two side niches and the inner cist. Rooms in order: entry passage, burial chamber, west niche, east niche, inner cist.

sections.name: The Mill Race
sections.danger: Otters, axolotls and platypus in the race
sections.about: Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): the flooded culvert under the Reedfall mill - the sluice chamber below the mill, the long race with a plank walk on its ledge, and the wheel pit at the far end. Rooms in order: sluice chamber, culvert run, wheel pit.

sections.name: The Old Well
sections.danger: Axolotls, lizards and an opossum in the drain
sections.about: Pass 2 wave A (owner 2026-10-21): the cistern at the bottom of a croft well - a ring of rubble round the sump under the shaft of daylight, and the old drain off to a dry sump. Rooms in order: the cistern, the drain sump.

sections.name: The Undercity
sections.danger: Drowned pirates, tide constructs, ghouls, temple guards and mummies in the buried streets
sections.about: Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the middle level of the Serpent Underways, a huge looped ruin under the hidden ruined city round Suncoil's great temple - a grid of buried plazas (shrines, markets, tombs, colonnades, cisterns, fallen plazas lit through collapsed streets) joined by two avenues through the forum and narrow lanes choked with fallen masonry, round the ruined blocks. The stair down from the Serpent Catacombs arrives in the north-west plaza; the north-east quarter's chapel cellar door (north side) and the sea-cliff door (south-east corner) make a three-door shortcut across Suncoil with the Catacombs' door; the forum's stair goes down to the Sunken Sanctum; a flooded way in the south-west cistern leads under the sea to the Cenote Deeps on Coilmere. Rooms in order: an 8 x 6 lattice of plazas, west to east, then south to north.

sections.name: The Sunken Sanctum
sections.danger: Mummies, death knights and a sunken colossus; the Drowned Lich King on his throne in the apse
sections.about: Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): the deep end of the Serpent Underways, a flooded temple hall below the Undercity's forum - a landing where the forum stair comes out of the water, a nave whose aisles are flooded either side of the causeway, drowned colonnades, two chapels, and the apse where the Drowned Lich King sits. Rooms in order: landing, vestibule, nave, apse, north chapel, south chapel.

sections.name: The Frozen Deep
sections.danger: Yetis, polar bears, frost golems, glacier trolls and paladins; the Rime Matriarch in her lair
sections.about: Pass 2 wave C (owner 2026-10-21): a vast ice cavern under the Rimewater Ice Caves - ice chambers looped round glacier islands, the frozen falls in the great hall, and the Rime Matriarch's lair at the bottom, down one winding way off the east end. The stair from the Ice Caves' throne cave comes down on the west side; a stair in the north-east chamber climbs to the Mirror Vaults under Hornmere. Rooms in order: a 6 x 4 lattice of chambers west to east, then south to north, then the lair.
